value.rationale: Sharp endpoint regularity of analytic semigroups is a natural quantitative operator-theory invariant. The work determines every sharp order constant, proves nonattainment for finite time, derives a surprising exact disappearance of the quadratic finite-size error at order two, and identifies a structural nodal transition for the third derivative. This relates semigroup smoothing to kernel zero geometry and sharp periodization, not an arbitrary numerical slice. No claim for general semigroups or inner Lp norms.
